name: @kiwa/dapp
description: Headless E2E test fixture for dApps on anvil forks (Playwright + viem). Renamed from @kiwa/core in v1.0.

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --testTimeout 15000
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --testTimeout 15000 --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/anvil-default-keys.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/anvil-pool.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/eip1271.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/index.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/injector-script.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/types.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/wait-for-wallet-connected.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**'
